// diagnostic

E0382

`#Memo` cannot mark `{field}`.

What

`#Memo` cannot mark `{field}`.

Why

A stored computed result needs a formula and its dependency set; field `#Memo` does not take cache arguments.

Fix

Write `#Memo` before `{field}: T -> expr` without arguments.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0382: tests/ui/memo_field_invalid.stderr.

Error [E0382]: `#Memo` cannot mark `value`.

    |     ^^^^^
 Why: A stored computed result needs a formula and its dependency set; field `#Memo` does not take cache arguments.
 Fix: write `#Memo` before `value: T -> expr` without arguments.
